module_summary: AXI-Lite 1-to-NS splitter for single-cycle slaves: decodes the address into one-hot per-slave valids, pipelines the selected slave's response/read data by index, and queues responses in B and R FIFOs with outstanding counters for backpressure.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid into the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid; launches one-hot slave read and read count.

anchors.name: m_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: One-hot slave write select decoded from skid-buffered address.

anchors.name: m_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: One-hot slave read select decoded from read address.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: Write data ready, set after AW accepted until WVALID arrives.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid when B FIFO not empty.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read response valid when R FIFO not empty.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data broadcast directly to all slaves.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data returned from the R FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Concatenated slave read data, indexed by last_read_index.

anchors.name: read_rdata
anchors.why: Selected slave read word registered before R FIFO.

anchors.name: last_read_index
anchors.why: Delayed slave index selecting read data and read response.

anchors.name: write_count
anchors.why: Outstanding write count; drives bfull backpressure.

anchors.name: read_count
anchors.why: Outstanding read count; drives read_full backpressure.

anchors.name: bfull
anchors.why: Write path full; blocks AW skid buffer acceptance.

anchors.name: read_full
anchors.why: Read path full; deasserts ARREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready while outstanding reads not full.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write address ready from AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: awskid_valid
anchors.why: Buffered AW valid that triggers slave select and count update.

anchors.name: write_awskidready
anchors.why: Accept from AW skid when W done and not full.

anchors.name: awskid_addr
anchors.why: Buffered slave index used for one-hot decode.

anchors.name: write_bindex
anchors.why: Slave index selecting the write response.

anchors.name: read_index
anchors.why: Registered read slave index from ARADDR.

anchors.name: write_resp
anchors.why: Selected slave write response written into B FIFO.

anchors.name: read_resp
anchors.why: Selected slave read response written into R FIFO.

anchors.name: write_response
anchors.why: Delayed write-done pulse pushing response into B FIFO.

anchors.name: read_result
anchors.why: Delayed read pulse pushing data into R FIFO.

anchors.name: m_axi_awprot
anchors.why: Latched write protection bits to slaves.

groups.name: write_address_decode
groups.description: AW skid buffer and one-hot slave write select with WREADY handshake.

groups.name: write_response_path
groups.description: Response selection pipeline, B FIFO and outstanding write counter.

groups.name: read_address_decode
groups.description: One-hot slave read select from read address.

groups.name: read_data_path
groups.description: Indexed read data mux, R FIFO and outstanding read counter.

groups.name: write_data_broadcast
groups.description: Write data and strobes passed directly to all slaves.
